segments.name: Mortgage technology and brokerage
segments.description: Provides mortgage brokerage services and technology solutions to Canadian mortgage agents, brokers, brokerages and consumers.
segments.evidence: Pineapple Financial is a Canadian mortgage technology and brokerage company.

revenueModel.text: The company earns subscription fees from agents using the Platform, per-deal pre-underwriting fees, and commissions from lender partners on funded mortgages.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue model is diversified across platform subscriptions, pre-risk assessment services and lender partner commissions.
